verdict.rationale: Beamer documents feedback collection and prioritization, public/private roadmaps, and in-app and push notifications for announcements. None of the evidence says customers are automatically notified when the status of a feature they requested changes. The 'close the feedback loop' line refers to support-app integrations, which is an adjacent feature, not a status-change notification workflow.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically notify customers when the status of their requested feature changes
